data.name: Tricky Treats Hex
data.description: A gingerbread witch learns a unique hex that lets her create a piece of candy or a similar sweet as a full-round action. If eaten by the witch or a single creature she designates when she creates it, the sweet functions as goodberry or a polypurpose panacea (UM) (as determined at creation). Anyone else that eats the sweet becomes nauseated (Fortitude negates); a creature nauseated by the sweet can attempt a new saving throw each round at the end of its turn to end this effect. A creature that fails its initial save is also affected as per the scar (UM) hex for %1 days, except that at extended range, the witch can use only harmful hexes on the creature. She can create %2 sweets each day. These sweets retain their potency for 24 hours and then turn to crumbs.|WitchLVL|WitchLVL+INT
